hints: The sign % is read "percent". Think about what "per cent" means.
Percent means "out of 100". The number before the % sign is the part, and 100 is the whole.

steps.why: "Cent" means 100, as in the 100 centavos in one peso.

trapNotes.25 out of 10: Percent is always out of 100, not out of 10. 25 out of 10 would be more than the whole.
trapNotes.100 out of 25: This is upside down. The number before % is the part, and 100 is the whole.
trapNotes.25 out of 1,000: Percent is out of 100, not out of 1,000.
